text:
maya: Quick sync — I've been enabling FP8 kernels on H100 and L40S for the new model bring-up (mistral-7b / opt-13b). Seeing solid throughput but some accuracy cracks at longer seqs. Wanted to capture experiments and a few gotchas. :eyes:

devon: pls dump eval numbers? which evals and configs?

maya: running MMLU, BoolQ, and a small long-context QA set (seq 4k). Configs: baseline fp16, fp8_h100 kernel, fp8_l40s kernel. Batch=1/2, kv-cache enabled. Basic envs: `REDWOOD_FP8=1` and kernel selection `--kernel fp8_h100` or `--kernel fp8_l40s`.

liam: rough numbers quick?

maya: short paste from local runs — all numbers are delta vs fp16 (higher = worse):
```
MMLU: fp8_h100 +2.6% acc-drop, fp8_l40s +1.8%
BoolQ: fp8_h100 +3.1% drop, fp8_l40s +0.9%
LongQA (4k): fp8_h100 often hallucinated/inconsistent, ppl/ll= diverged after ~600 tokens in some seeds
Throughput: H100 fp8 ~1.9x, L40S fp8 ~1.6x vs fp16
```

devon: OK that MMLU drop is non-trivial. any pattern by seq len or batch?

maya: pattern: short seq (<512) pretty safe. Degradation grows with seq and when reusing KV cache across calls (chat-style). Suspect accumulation/rounding in KV and attention softmax. H100 kernel shows slightly worse deltas than L40S.

eva: saw similar with AWQ vs GPTQ — quantization scheme matters. Are you using per-channel scales or per-tensor?

maya: per-channel by default. I tried switching to per-tensor and drops got worse. Also tried keeping layernorm in fp32 — that helps ~0.3% on MMLU but not enough.

liam: could be mixed-precision reduction on softmax/CAST boundaries. Any NaNs/inf seen?

maya: on batch>1 with H100 fp8 kernel we saw rare NaNs in attention on one seed. LoS: "RuntimeError: nan encountered in matmul". Repro script attached locally. Workaround: set `REDWOOD_FP8_DENORM_FLUSH=1` (flush subnormals) and it prevents NaN but increases error a bit.

profiler-bot: micro-benchmarks uploaded: /artifacts/fp8_h100_microbench_1768804321.csv (latency/throughput/kernels) :bar_chart:

devon: interesting — flush fixes NaNs but higher bias. Maybe denorm handling differs between H100 and L40S libraries. Did you try dynamic rounding or stochastic rounding?

maya: tried `REDWOOD_FP8_DYN_ROUND=1` (our dynamic rounding shim) — reduces MMLU drop from 2.6% -> 1.7% on H100, but performance down ~8%.

liam: what about mixed-precision split: keep softmax & logits matmul in fp32, rest fp8?

maya: did that: `--keep-softmax-fp32` flag. Big win: MMLU delta on H100 goes to +0.9%, BoolQ +1.0%. LongQA still tricky but more stable. Throughput loses a bit (1.7x instead of 1.9x). Recommend as default fallback.

eva: L40S needed a smaller clip range on activation quantization to avoid overflow, right?

maya: yes — L40S kernel has a tighter dynamic range. Setting `REDWOOD_FP8_CLIP=6.0` (default 8.0) fixed a bunch of small errors and reduced MMLU drop to +0.6% on L40S. H100 needed clip=7.0.

devon: any kernel bugs discovered (e.g., fused-kernel ordering, transpose differences)?

maya: found one: H100 fp8 fused GEMM uses an optimization that assumes no KV-cache reuse transpose, which yields incorrect layout when we do incremental decode (chat). Repro: incremental generation with `--use-cache` + `--kernel fp8_h100` produces shifted attention keys after the first reuse. Patch: disable fused-transpose via `REDWOOD_FP8_FUSED_TRANSPOSE=0` — fixes layout but perf drops ~12%. Filed GH issue #1427. :bug:

liam: can we do a canary rollout: global flag default to disabled until we patch?

maya: proposing defaults for hosted: enable FP8 on new dedicated clusters but with `--keep-softmax-fp32`, `REDWOOD_FP8_DYN_ROUND=1` off, `REDWOOD_FP8_FUSED_TRANSPOSE=0` on H100 for now. For L40S enable with clip=6.0 and fused transpose on.

devon: add to test matrix: MMLU, BoolQ, LongQA 4k, chat replay tests with kv-cache reuse and batch 1/2/4. Also add AWQ/GPTQ variants.

maya: noted. I'll add a bakeoff script to infra-evals and run nightly. Quick snippet I'm adding to the harness: 
```
# run one config
REDWOOD_FP8=1 \ 
REDWOOD_FP8_CLIP=6.0 \ 
REDWOOD_FP8_DYN_ROUND=0 \ 
REDWOOD_FP8_FUSED_TRANSPOSE=0 \ 
python eval.py --model mistral-7b --kernel fp8_h100 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --kv-cache
```

profiler-bot: nightly job created: `fp8-bakeoff-nightly` and will post summaries in #eng-ml at 04:00 UTC.

eva: action items?

maya: short list:
- (maya) push repro + fix flags and GH issue for H100 fused-transpose (#1427)
- (devon) add tests to canary matrix and gate on long-chat regression thresholds
- (liam) coordinate with infra for dedicated cluster tunes on L40S clip defaults
- (eva) run AWQ vs GPTQ quick comparison under fp8 settings and post deltas

liam: I can take infra tune.

devon: will add regression thresholds.

maya: thanks all. I'll drop the raw logs + repro link in the thread later. :thumbsup:

liam: :rocket:
